events.body:
The cancellation was made by the driver, so NS-0 routes the case to the no-show branch (NS-1/NS-2) because the driver's recorded reason is rider no-show [F4][F11][F13][NS-0]. The fee can only stand if NS-1 (i)–(iii) all hold [NS-1].

(i) Arrival was confirmed by the driver's own tap, recorded as driver_tap at 18:24:35 — the record is not a platform auto-confirmation and I do not describe it as one [F6][NS-1].

(ii) At that tap the GPS placed the car 41 m from the pickup point (closest approach overall 38 m), i.e. inside the 200 m arrival radius [F6][F1][NS-1].

The driver's post-trip statement that he waited more than 4 minutes and called twice [F13] is consistent with, and not needed beyond, the timeline record [F2][F3]. The heavy rain [F16] and the Maxwell Road speed band [F14] do not alter the no-show test, which is about the driver's presence and wait at the pickup [NS-1].

Because every NS-1 condition is met, NS-2 (which would require full refund and a possible account flag) is not engaged; the $6.61 cancellation fee stands and the trace marks no account action [F18][NS-1][NS-2][RD-6].

events.title: Notices sent to rider and driver
events.body:
RIDER: We looked into your cancellation and the $6.61 no-show fee stands, so no refund is due. Two facts decided it: your driver tapped to confirm arrival and was within the pickup area (about 40 metres away), then stayed there for roughly four minutes before cancelling. You messaged asking for two more minutes after that arrival, but the ride still wasn't boarded when the driver cancelled. Nothing is being added to your account. The fee was already covered when the trip was cancelled, so there's nothing to pay now.

DRIVER: Your $6.61 no-show cancellation fee is upheld and will be paid to you as a Ryde voucher. Two facts decided it: you tapped to confirm arrival at the pickup, and at that moment you were inside the pickup area (about 40 metres away). You then stayed within that area for roughly four minutes until you cancelled, so the required wait was met. No action is being taken on your account. The voucher is applied automatically — nothing further is needed from you.
